text_post: Question Game After reading a post in this forum, I was thinking about how good/bad it might be to do like a "question game" (I ask you a question, you answer honestly and then it's your turn) during a date or something like that? I think it has got a great potential to build comfort and intimacy, you can be funny and, if well-played it could ease the way to a kiss. The only drawback I'm thinking of is that you/her might run out of (interesting) questions and it may possibly cause awkwardness. What do you think guys? and what kind of questions would you ask to a girl?

text_post: Yeah, the thing is it isn't question, answer, question, answer. It's a question, tell me about that story, relating, banter, then segue way into another question. Wash, rinse, repeat. One question should theoretically last a while. Check out the Gentlemans Guide to Online Dating for Cajun's question game.
